Interface WhoHumanCheck

All Known Implementing Classes:
TurnstileHumanCheck
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface WhoHumanCheck
Decides whether a request to one of who's public, costly endpoints comes from a person rather than a script: a bot check such as Cloudflare Turnstile. who checks POST /who/email/send and POST /who/email/sign-in when the application has a bean of this type, and checks nothing without one. A refused request never reaches the endpoint: no email is sent and no code is tried.

A check that throws refuses the request. An implementation decides itself what to do when its vendor cannot be reached.
